motion.name: hero-focus-pull
motion.purpose: Cinematic optical lens focus-pull reveal on the opening Newsreader display statement.

motion.name: leaf-drift
motion.value: 16s-25s linear continuous diagonal float with rotation
motion.purpose: Ambient autumn maple leaf depth layers drifting silently across the opening frame.

motion.name: fps-walking-gait
motion.value: sin/cos scroll head-bob ±5.5px / ±4.5px / ±0.35deg + per-scene forward dolly scale 1.0->1.24 + 3D fine-pointer lookaround
motion.purpose: Simulates an eye-level first-person walk down the city avenue while keeping horizon framing seamless.

motion.name: six-scene-dolly-walk
motion.value: 560vh desktop / 460vh mobile sticky narrative walkthrough across SC 01-SC 06
motion.purpose: Reveals six sequential chapters introducing Jobjab's philosophy and 37 production systems as the user scrolls forward.

motion.name: cloud-veil-sweep
motion.value: horizontal radial mist seam pulses across transitions [1/6..5/6]
motion.purpose: Softly bridges transitions between daylight, canopy, twilight, harbor night, and studio overlook paintings.

motion.name: chapter-window-parallax
motion.value: oversized backdrop y -9%->9% and scale 1.08->1.01 across viewport traversal
motion.purpose: Layered depth window effect across below-the-fold and subpage cinema chapter banners.

narrative.overview:
Inspired by Makoto Shinkai and CoMix Wave animation cinematography, the portfolio opens on a single unbroken widescreen painted avenue bathed in warm autumn sunlight and azure clouds. Monumental `Newsreader` serif headlines emerge through a gentle optical focus pull over subtle atmospheric bottom glazes, while a floating studio masthead links projects, architecture tracks, and live SMPTE timecodes without enclosing bars.

Beneath the full-viewport opening reel (`SC 01`), four painted horizon chapters anchor every track across 37 real engineering systems on dark obsidian-slate archive plates framed exclusively by crisp ivory hairlines.

rules.name: The Glaze-Before-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every heading or paragraph layered over hand-painted artwork sits above a directional dark gradient glaze so text legibility never drops below readable contrast.

rules.name: The Zero-Ghost-Frame Rule
rules.body: Archive frames rely strictly on subtle ivory hairline borders (`rgba(248, 241, 227, 0.14)`) with zero drop shadows.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Never stack an uppercase eyebrow label above any heading; place scene indicators inline beside chapter controls or below headings.

dos: Do keep hero horizon paintings unobstructed in the upper center sky and stage editorial headings cleanly in the bottom-left and bottom-right corners.
Do disable continuous leaf drift animations cleanly under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
Do pair painted backgrounds with directional dark contrast scrims beneath overlaid text.
donts: Don't place uppercase eyebrow kickers above headings.
Don't combine `1px` borders with wide `box-shadow` drop shadows on archive cards.
Don't invent unverified trading PnL, APR, revenue, or client claims.
